notes: v566 — fixes what you just caught: switching the 💧 floor to $1m changed the label but not the counts, because the counts still came from grades computed under the OLD floor. The radar now names the floor the GRADES actually used, and if the card is set to something different it says so outright: ‘these counts were graded at 💧 Any, but the card is now set to $1m — open the report card to re-grade before trusting them’. So the numbers can never quietly belong to a setting you've changed. Hard-refresh (Ctrl+F5), then open the 📋 report card once to re-grade at $1m.
